bank.prompt: A random protein split puts close homologs in both train and test. Explain its supported generalization claim; propose a stronger split and limitations.
bank.solution: Random split can measure interpolation among related sequences, not distant-family generalization. Group by a declared homology threshold, check residual similarity and state family/time biases.
